name: AddIns
description: A collection of AddIn objects that represents all the add-ins available to Microsoft Excel, regardless of whether they're installed.
remarks: This list corresponds to the list of add-ins displayed in the Add-Ins dialog box.
example:
Sub DisplayAddIns()
 Worksheets("Sheet1").Activate
 rw = 1
 For Each ad In Application.AddIns
 Worksheets("Sheet1").Cells(rw, 1) = ad.Name
 Worksheets("Sheet1").Cells(rw, 2) = ad.Installed
 rw = rw + 1
 Next
End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of objects in the collection.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Returns a single object from a collection.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Filename As String, [CopyFile As Variant]) As AddIn
methods.description: Adds a new add-in file to the list of add-ins. Returns an AddIn object.

parameters.name: Filename
parameters.description: The name of the file that contains the add-in or the ProgID of the automation add-in that you want to add to the list in the add-in manager.

parameters.name: CopyFile
parameters.description: Ignored if the add-in file is on a hard disk. True to copy the add-in to your hard disk, if the add-in is on a removable medium (such as a compact disc). False to have the add-in remain on the removable medium. If this argument is omitted, Microsoft Excel displays a dialog box and asks you to choose.
